audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-17 CLOSURE ROUND - the pure flip, no new ink. BOTH report-017 boxes close at this single flip - the issue-17 opener chains (print 3-4, 15-17, 20+22, 31-33: the R931 part one - Jousting in D&D, Vampires in the Dungeon, Sights and Sounds in D&D, the Magic Munchkin, the Scholar and the Crs-tchen, the Tesseracts, A Short History of Adamanite, the Angels) and A Wizard With A Difference (print 10-13, the R932 part two, the Ward eight specialized wizard variants) - 2 closed / 0 open in tools/dragon_gap_report_017.md; the eight-chain walk completes in three rounds (the R931 opener part one, the R932 opener part two, this flip), the issue-17 three-round shape the Curtiss split set. Issues 2-17 ALL CLOSED. Registry ground truth unchanged: 1313 loaded / 1338 base lua / 25 never-load (the R924 re-measure). Watch: the brawling long-term-effects sequel STILL does not print (watch TD 18).

The issue-17 walk (the R931 opener part one carrying the seven chains, the R932 opener part two carrying the Ward wizard article, this flip) covered The Dragon Vol. III No. 3 (August 1978), the Curtiss-provided scan voice, single-voice - the mistral transcript of the uploaded Dm17.pdf; no archive.org djvu cross-check exists for issue 17. Print folio = PDF page minus two, verified at the R931 page feet. Registry ground truth unchanged: 1313 loaded / 1338 base lua / 25 never-load (the R924 re-measure). Watch: the brawling long-term-effects sequel STILL does not print (watch TD 18).
banner.sentinel: No print quirks ride this flip - the as-scanned garbles of the openers (the vampire 8:69 strength print, the Crs-tchen EPT-style descending armor class conversion, the Mercy AC minus 1 sharing the sentinel value, the Ward article spell-list garbles Dispel! Magic, Pall-wall, Extention, Telekenisis, Ventriliquism, Animate Deat, the Etherfulness/Etherialness/Etheriainess spread, Replusion Field, the twice-printed End All Barriers, the Movement fifth-level row that never prints and the unlabeled Control overflow row) pin sentinel or as-scanned in the R931 and R932 layers and ride the transcript and the wizard-roster data file, noted never silent; this round flips the two report boxes and touches no ink.
